jobs.description:

The position is full-time from  24th of November to 12th of December, working the night shift from 11 PM to 7 AM. During this period, we experience increased activity due to the Christmas shopping season. As the Christmas peak approaches, the warehouse gets busier, so you must be prepared to work weekends as part of the Facility Team.

Your main responsibility will be to ensure that the AutoStore system operates reliably and efficiently – also during the night.

• Carrying out regular battery changes on the 45 AutoStore robots

• Monitoring the robots and responding if something is not working as it should

You do not need to be a robotics technician, but you should be curious about technology, able to understand how things work together and eager to learn the system.

• Hold a valid forklift certificate and have experience operating forklifts

• Have a good technical understanding and an interest in electronics and automated systems

• Work independently and take responsibility

• Are practical and not afraid to get hands-on

• Enjoy a varied working day where tasks may change

• Are a team player who is always willing to help when needed

• Are comfortable working night shifts and can maintain your energy and concentration throughout the shift

Experience with AutoStore or other automated warehouse systems is a definite advantage, but the most important things are your technical curiosity and willingness to learn.

The salary will be 156,39 kr/hour+35 in night supplement.

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

• Customer impact. Real customers use our products everyday, you'll see your work impacting real people.

• Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

Here’s what that looks like day to day

• In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

• You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

• You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

• You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

• You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

• Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

This includes things like...

• Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

• Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

• Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

• Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

• Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

You’re a great match if

• You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

• You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

• You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

• You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

• You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

Nice to haves

• You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

• Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

• Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

• Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

• Experience building systemic or open-world games

What always matters to us at Triband

• You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

• You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

• You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

• You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

• You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

Practicalities

• For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

We offer

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

**

Are you a hands-on, security focused engineer ready to help build a technical security foundation? If you thrive on turning compliance frameworks into real-world technical control while staying closely connected to daily operations, this job is for you.

Working closely with our Head of IT and Security, you will turn our ISMS (ISO/IEC 27001, NIS2, and the EU AI Act) into operating technical reality by designing, implementing, and operating the controls, tooling, and secure configurations that protect Space Inventor across our Corporate, Missions, and SatOPS zones. This is a role focused on establishing new capabilities rather than maintaining an existing setup. Alongside hands-on security engineering, you will co-own and deliver day-to-day IT support, keeping you grounded in user needs and the operational reality of our environment.

Given Space Inventors work you must be eligible for a Danish Personnel Security Clearance.

The job is located in Aalborg, Denmark.

Your Responsibilities

Qualifications

Experience: 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in IT security engineering or SecOps specifically building or maturing controls from scratch combined with solid IT support experience. Experience from regulated, manufacturing, critical-infrastructure, or OT environments is an advantage (space experience is not required).

Technical Proficiencies:

• Microsoft security stack: Entra ID, Conditional Access, Intune, M365 security, Defender (EDR), and ideally Sentinel or a comparable SIEM.

• Hardening baselines (CIS), patch management, and vulnerability scanning.

• Network security: Firewalls, segmentation, VPNs, and traffic monitoring.

• Scripting and automation with PowerShell.

• Incident response, triage, and log analysis.

Standards & Compliance: Solid working knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001 and NIS2 requirements; awareness of OT / IEC 62443 is a strong plus.

Education & Certifications: Degree in IT/cybersecurity or equivalent proven experience. Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft SC-200/AZ-500/SC-100, CompTIA Security+/CySA+, or GIAC GSEC/GCIH) are an advantage.

Personal Attributes: A builder mindset with strong initiative; pragmatic and risk-oriented; structured with audit-ready documentation; and a clear, discreet communicator who collaborates well across technical and non-technical teams.

What We Offer

• A full-time role with exposure to a variety of disciplines within space technology.

• A position in an exciting, rapidly growing industry with significant international reach.

• A chance to shape your role and responsibilities within a growing company.

• Great colleagues and several social events each year.

• Health insurance and additional employee benefits.

• Competitive salary and good working conditions.

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, apply by submitting your CV and application. If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact us via jobs@space-inventor.com, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

Interviews are held continuously until the right candidate is found.

Start date to be agreed, but preferably with start-up as soon as possible.

jobs.description:
The Department of Food Science at Aarhus University is seeking an Experimental Technician for a permanent position, starting on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position will focus on field-grown vegetables and pulses.

Start date and duration
1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. This is a permanent position on 32 hours per week. 

Job description

• 
Day-to-day care and maintenance of field trials involving vegetable crops and other annual crops

• 
Soil cultivation and weed control using a range of machinery and weeding methods

• 
Prevention and control of pests and other harmful organisms

• 
Harvesting, grading, storage and recording of field-grown crops

• 
Planning and carrying out field trials

• 
General horticultural tasks across the department involving vegetables and fruit

• 
Tasks are planned and carried out as part of a team of experienced horticulturalists and agricultural technicians, together with seasonal staff.

Your profile

• 
Day-to-day maintenance of areas used for agricultural crops outside experimental trials, as well as trials involving annual crops and fruit and berry species

• 
Soil cultivation and weed control using a range of machinery and weeding methods

• 
Prevention and control of pests and other harmful organisms

• 
Harvesting, grading, handling and storage of field-grown crops

• 
Handling soil samples

• 
Necessary certificates for operating the machinery available at AU-Auning for relevant field tasks

• 
General horticultural tasks across the department involving vegetables

Tasks are planned and carried out as part of a team of experienced horticulturalists and agricultural technicians, together with seasonal staff.

Who we are
The Department of Food Science is part of the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University. Its research covers a wide range of areas, including horticulture, fruit and vegetables, food quality and biochemistry, as well as sensory science and consumer science.

The department has approximately 60 full-time research staff, 70 PhD students and postdoctoral researchers, and 30 visiting students and researchers.

Most of the department's staff are based at Agro Food Park 48 in Skejby. Field trials involving outdoor crop production are carried out at AU Auning, near Gl. Estrup on the Djursland peninsula, where the team comprises five permanent staff members and two seasonal employees.

The department is characterised by openness, equality, dialogue and a strong sense of community. We consider these values an important part of the department's strategy and working environment.

Find out more about the Department of Food Science at www.food.au.dk.

What we offer

• 
A varied range of tasks in the field, orchard, workrooms and machinery shed

• 
An exciting workplace as part of a young, dedicated team

• 
Tasks tailored to your skills and competencies

• 
The opportunity to learn a great deal about vegetable production

• 
An insight into the world of research

• 
The opportunity to develop skills in planning and carrying out field trials

• 
A workplace in beautiful natural surroundings

• 
A workplace where employees are at the heart of everything we do

• 
Freedom and responsibility

• 
A job that contributes to the green transition

Place of work and area of employment
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the duty station is the AU-Auning Field Research Station, Department of Food Science, Gl. Estrup, Randersvej 8 H, 8963 Auning, Denmark.

Contact information
For further information, please contact: Assoc. Prof. Antonios Petridis, tel.: 20 63 36 82, email: apetridis@food.au.dk

Deadline
Applications must be received no later than 25 November 2026.

The engineering team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organisation that thrives on challenging work and doing it alongside exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry evolves rapidly, and our mission is to build a flexible, AI-driven platform that automates entity resolution, optimises data labelling pipelines, and creates predictive models that identify illicit patterns before they escalate.

Our data and solutions have been used to solve some of the world's most high-profile criminal cases and grow consumer access to cryptocurrency safely. Now, by pairing the industry's most trusted blockchain data with agents that reason, investigate, and act, we help our customers scale their workflows as the cryptocurrency economy becomes increasingly mainstream.

As a Staff Software Engineer within Investigations, you'll be a driving force in a team of engineers, taking ownership of technical direction and sharing responsibility for providing the right tools and the right data to build best in class customer experiences. You'll lead the design, build and maintenance of new customer facing web-features as well as the APIs and services backing them. A key part of this role is partnering closely with product managers and designers, leveraging your deep understanding of the underlying data platform to deliver impactful, scalable solutions to our customers.

**In This Role, You'll

**

• Lead the architecture, maintenance and development of serving cloud-native data ingest and aggregation processes that intake gigabytes of data per day

• Drive the delivery of features across our product suite that detect activities for market manipulation, fraud, behavioural patterning, and more

• Own and scale a high-performance services on AWS that handle thousands of requests per second

• Lead the team's modernisation efforts towards a streaming architecture, setting technical direction and best practices

• Own and drive the direction and enablement of our graphing platform, which is used across multiple products to drive and visualize understanding of our insights and data, both on and off the blockchains

• Debug and resolve production issues across multiple systems and services, guiding the team through complex technical challenges

• Mentor and grow engineers across the team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and collaboration

**We're Looking For Candidates Who Have

**

• Proven experience leading the design and implementation of cloud-native services-based systems in a major cloud provider like AWS or GCP

• A strong track record of mentoring engineers, leading cross-team projects, and driving design and technology decisions at a senior or lead level

• The ability to align technical execution with product and design partners, with a strong bias to ship and iterate

• Deep experience with object-oriented programming languages; we mostly use Java and typescript but appreciate a variety of languages!

• A strong technical background with extensive experience working directly on complex backend and/or frontend systems and projects, including in leadership or lead engineer roles

• Great pride from taking ownership of product ideas from inception through to production

• Good understanding of both frontend and backend best practices and paradigms.

• Integrated AI impactfully in customer-facing products or engineering infrastructure

**You Might Also Have

**

• Experience with AI-friendly and driven systems

• Exposure to or interest in the cryptocurrency technology ecosystem

• Terraform and Kubernetes knowledge

**Technologies We Use

**

• Java (Spring Boot)

• Typescript (React, Angular)

• Kafka (Warpstream)

• K8S

• Terraform

• PostgreSQL

**AI at Chainalysis

**AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

**About Chainalysis

**Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

**You belong here.

**At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

Compensation Range: DKK 870,000 - DKK 1,175,000

We are looking for a Software Engineer who wants to build and ship new features that quickly reach customers, on top of an engine that already runs at scale. You join our platform team, which owns several live domains that our customers depend on every day. The foundations are solid and well maintained, so your time goes into new use cases and features rather than firefighting. Whether you have a couple of years of experience or a few more, we would like to see your application.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and you work on features and product decisions that matter to end users.

• Build on a system with real scale behind it. The event system spans 8 domains, exposes 20+ event types as webhooks, and powers 10 configurable alert types for our end users - currently ~20k active configurations triggering ~200k events every weekday. The team owns 8+ public APIs end to end, crucial for customers' day-to-day business.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll join a talkative team of experienced domain experts who love discussing technical topics.

• Grow with support. Scoped, well-defined assignments to start, senior colleagues pairing and reviewing your work, and shared ownership of keeping things running.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so what you build lands in production fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills who is at home on live production systems.

• Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular building and running your own services in a modern cloud-based microservice and event-driven architecture.

• You are comfortable working on live production systems with high data volumes and migration paths, keeping quality, observability, reliability, and performance in mind.

• You enjoy talking tech: you like discussing technical topics widely, learning, and listening in on topics not always directly related to your own tasks.

• You are motivated by incremental, high-quality delivery on products that are already live, bringing a fresh perspective that helps rework existing infrastructure where it is holding us back, and you treat the tools already in our platform as solid building blocks.

• Nice to have: Flink and stateful processing (or the willingness to learn it, since it is widely used here), relational databases, and Grafana and Prometheus, our “bread and butter”.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Improve, extend and run the live domains our team owns, including telemetry storage and APIs, the event system, and the alerting engine, without disrupting production.

• Build and run your own services, with migration paths when architecture or data formats need to change.

• Work closely with the internal teams building products on top of the platform you help shape.

• Keep the platform reliable and observable at high data volumes.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?
